scores.justification: The objectives and scope are clearly defined, but the project schedule/plan mentioned in the brief is missing from the report content. The introduction focuses solely on the Member module rather than the project as a whole.
Wireframes are provided for the dashboard and lesson views, though they are somewhat basic. Audience modeling and full requirement specifications are only briefly touched upon.
The navigation structure and use cases are well-mapped, but the ERD is mentioned as 'shared' without being visually presented in this specific report section. The logic for the lesson flow is sound.

Excellent explanation of the shared helper class and the rationale for using HttpCacheability.NoCache. The code snippets are relevant, though a more detailed discussion on the SQL transaction for account deletion would strengthen the score.
The document is well-structured with a clear table of contents and professional formatting. The 'lessons learned' section is reflective and demonstrates good project management insight.
